R619.note: Replacing the hand-rolled inline-protocol socket with redis-py's hset frames each argument as a RESP bulk string, closing CRLF/whitespace command splitting; the new dependency and client swap are stated and cache semantics are unchanged.

R620.note: execFileSync with an argv array closes the shell vector, but the added ^\d{1,5}x\d{1,5}$ allowlist rejects geometry forms the original accepted (e.g. 50%, 200x200>, x200, 200x200+10+10) and no contract calls for that restriction.

R621.note: Content type is derived from magic bytes against a fixed image allowlist and the caller value never reaches put_object; the ValueError rejection of non-matching bytes is stated and is exactly what the contract requires.

R622.note: Direct tar invocation plus the leading-dash rejection closes shell and flag injection, but the cleaned != archiveName / '..' prefix rejection is a new path restriction the contract does not call for and turns names like ./x.tar or a//b.tar (accepted before) into a 500.

R623.note: Ownership check against the loaded invoice's AccountId returning NotFound is the right shape, but it keys on an invented account_id claim; if the app issues no such claim every legitimate owner gets 404, which the write-up states only as a follow-up to wire in.

R624.note: Encode.forHtml applied to both fields at the element-content insertion point closes the vector; the added org.owasp.encoder dependency is stated and rendering of ordinary input is unchanged.

R625.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) is the correct CSPRNG replacement; dropping the client_nonce prefix and the longer 64-char token are stated plainly and block no legitimate reset flow.

R626.note: Exact WHATWG URL origin equality replaces the prefix check and the missing-header path (the planted 'OrMissing' weakness) now fails closed with the existing 403 JSON; both changes are stated and same-origin browser transfers still succeed.

R627.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a SqlParameter is the right API, but the fix silently assumes the proc's parameter is named @CustomerId (the original EXEC was positional) and the Size=50 causes SqlClient to truncate longer customerId values; neither is disclosed.

R628.note: Sniffed-type allowlist, random server-side name, O_EXCL write and an updated read path with the stored name returned in the response meet the contract, but the added 5 MiB MaxBytesReader cap is a new size bound the contract does not call for and rejects large avatars the original accepted.

R629.note: Argument list with shell=False closes the shell vector and input_path is prefixed by UPLOAD_DIR so it cannot start with '-'; the switch to the absolute /usr/bin/libreoffice path is stated and matches the standard distro location (path traversal in filename is out of scope for this CWE).

R630.note: std::string::at() replaces the unchecked operator[] and refuses out-of-range peer offsets with std::out_of_range instead of corrupting memory; the throw is stated and in-range edits behave exactly as before, though the caller must catch it to avoid a peer-triggered abort.

R631.note: Null-guarded unboxing in applyDiscount (defaulting to 0) and a short-circuit null check in the sibling isDiscountApplied honor the repository's documented null contract exactly as the stated contract requires.
